scope: Convergence analysis across 127 rules (67 PURE + 17 PURE_GAP + 26 EU + 17 RECYCLASS). Focus: cross-pillar contradictions, intra-pillar gaps, redundancies, reverse gaps (EU/RC without PURE coverage), and prioritized recommendations. Complements audit-pure-methodology-consistency.md (which covered PURE methodology vs catalog).

summary.coverage_note: 19 of 43 EU+RC rules have an equivalent PURE or PG (44%). 24 are pure regional pillar; 8 of those are real gaps where PURE should adopt.

findings.title: Throughput drift: RC-02 BLOCK vs EU-26 FLAG vs P-62 FLAG
findings.description: Three rules evaluate recycler throughput on the same data (monthly_input vs licensed/capacity) with incompatible severities and non-aligned thresholds. RC-02 blocks; EU-26 and P-62 only flag. Same MassID can PASS PURE/EU and be retroactively BLOCKED by RecyClass.
findings.evidence: RC-02 (recyclass.md:91): 'total_certified_kg_12m <= licensed_input_volume_kg. Excesso bloqueia.' EU-26 (eu.md:226) FLAG. P-62 (RULE_REGISTER): 'if input > capacity threshold then FLAG' SEVERITY=FLAG.
findings.resolution: Raise EU-26 and P-62 to BLOCK when region=EU and participant is RC-scoped, OR consolidate into single ThroughputCheck with severity=max(RC,EU,PURE). Version config/throughput-thresholds.json with 0.9 (FLAG) and 1.0 (BLOCK).

findings.title: Storage limits (RC-03) without PURE/EU equivalent vs FIFO (P-65)
findings.description: RC-03 requires avg_stock_3m <= licensed_storage; P-65 only enforces FIFO ordering. A tank above permit can still satisfy P-65 (sequence ordered) while violating storage permit.
findings.evidence: RC-03 (recyclass.md:118): 'se avg_3m > licensed_storage_volume_kg → FLAG; >10% → BLOCK'. P-65 (pure.md:401): 'sequence complete and ordered' — sem referência a volume.
findings.resolution: Create PG-NN 'Recycler storage permit compliance' — PURE should validate storage compliance as part of homologation. Decision: create PG or keep only in RC.

findings.title: process_type enum incoherent: P-50 vs RecyClass §5
findings.description: P-50 enum is [mechanical, chemical, closed_loop, downcycling, upcycling]. RecyClass requires sub-distinction (closed_loop_mechanical vs closed_loop_chemical) and accepts solvent-based, dissolution, depolymerization. UI captures 'chemical' in P-50; RecyClass auditor asks for sub-type → re-work.
findings.evidence: P-50 (pure.md:334): 'Enum: mechanical | chemical | closed_loop | downcycling | upcycling'. cross-validation.md:201: 'RC pode requerer process types adicionais'.
findings.resolution: Extend P-50 enum to RecyClass-compatible superset. Document in ADR.

findings.title: hazard_flag (P-17) vs EWC-derived hazardous_flag (EU-03) — source ambiguous
findings.description: P-17 reads hazard_flag from MassID declaration; EU-03 reads hazardous_flag from EWC code lookup. When declaration diverges from EWC, which wins? Silent validation bug risk.
findings.evidence: P-17 (pure.md:162-165): 'Reject if hazardous toxic...'. EU-03 (eu.md:65-67): 'If EWC is hazardous, additional restrictions apply'. cross-validation.md:71 explicitly warns about divergence.
findings.resolution: Define hazardous_flag as canonically EWC-derived when region=EU. Manual declaration can only escalate (PURE can mark hazardous what EWC doesn't), never de-escalate. P-17 and EU-03 become facets of same gate.

findings.title: Trigger phase incompatible: P-67/PG-12 INGEST-only vs PURE §14 30-day timer
findings.description: PURE §14 verbatim: 'If any participant fails to provide a response within 30 days, may be permanently disqualified'. Neither P-67 nor PG-12 implements the timer; both act only on ingest or exception. No EXCEPTION_TIMEOUT trigger exists.
findings.evidence: P-67 (pure.md:412): trigger='severe exception'. PG-12 (pure-gaps.md:343): trigger=MASSID_INGEST. PURE §14 not implemented (also documented in audit-pure-methodology-consistency.md A-04).
findings.resolution: Create PG-20 with trigger EXCEPTION_REQUEST_TIMEOUT running in periodic job. Aligns with PURE §14.

findings.title: P-67/PG-12 severity FLAG incompatible with PURE 'seriously punishing' language
findings.description: PURE §8.7 describes propagation as 'seriously punishing'. Both rules are FLAG (manual review) — do not block emission. Loophole: bad actor continues emitting TRC while Ops reviews.
findings.evidence: P-67 severity=FLAG (RULE_REGISTER). audit-pure-methodology-consistency.md risks #8: 'metodologia usa linguagem seriously punishing, sugere BLOCK não FLAG'.
findings.resolution: Raise P-67 to BLOCK in severity_class='severe', keep FLAG for 'minor'. Same for PG-12.

findings.title: P-03 vs PG-01 (KYC) — disposition 'Keep/Modify' creates permanent overlap
findings.description: cross-validation.md says 'PG-01 substitutes P-03' but RULE_REGISTER shows P-03 with Disposition='Keep/Modify'. Both would stay active → duplicate user messages.
findings.evidence: cross-validation.md:97 + cross-validation.md:273 'DEPRECATE P-03 once PG-01 in production'.
findings.resolution: Mark P-03 as disposition='Deprecated when PG-01 deployed' in rules.json; code emits silent warning when PG-01 active.

findings.title: RC-15 reads SubcontractedRecycling entity not written by any rule
findings.description: RC-15 reads SubcontractedRecycling.subcontractorId/externalCertRef. No PURE/PG rule writes these fields. Schema entity SubcontractedRecycling does not exist — RC-15 fails silently if schema not provisioned.
findings.evidence: recyclass.md:425-426: 'reads: [SubcontractedRecycling.subcontractorId, ...]'. Cross-check rules.json: SubcontractedRecycling appears only in RC-15 reads, never in writes.
findings.resolution: Schema delta (IMP-56) must include SubcontractedRecycling entity with MassID link. Populated via UI or Carrot webhook. Add PG-NN 'subcontracted_recycling present when flag=TRUE'.

findings.title: RC-11 (recycled content split) reads RecyclingOutcome.preConsumerPct not written by P-47/P-50/P-57
findings.description: RC-11 requires pre_consumer_pct + post_consumer_pct = recycled_content_pct. P-47 only computes eligible_kg=net_kg*factor without consumer_class split.
findings.evidence: RC-11 (recyclass.md:328-329). P-47 (pure.md:316) no split. cross-validation.md:58 'Schema delta (IMP-56) deve incluir: RecyclingOutcome.preConsumerPct, postConsumerPct'.
findings.resolution: Confirm IMP-56 schema delta; add PG-NN 'Pre/post-consumer split captured at MassID origin' for EN 15343:2007 consistency.

findings.title: EU-22 (audit trail) presumes all writes logged, but no P-XX declares AuditLog write
findings.description: EU-22 requires every change logged with user attribution. The 67 P-XX in rules.json only write to ValidationResult — never declare AuditLog write. Coverage depends entirely on Prisma/NestJS middleware.
findings.evidence: rules.json: no rule has writes including 'AuditLog'. eu.md:204-207.
findings.resolution: Add Prisma middleware onChange→AuditLog. Add PG-NN 'AuditLog integrity check' validating count(audit_log)>=count(distinct entity_changes) in nightly job.

findings.title: EU-17 (mass consistency cross-doc) presumes WTN/Annex VII not in MVP Malta
findings.description: EU-17 cross-checks WTN + Annex VII + dMRV + receipt. For MVP Malta, EU-07..EU-12 (WTN/Annex VII) are out of scope. EU-17 today only compares receipt_kg vs eligible_kg, duplicating P-57 without adding value.
findings.evidence: eu.md:282 'EU-10..EU-12 só ativam em Fase 2'. cross-validation.md:159-161.
findings.resolution: Explicit conditional in EU-17: 'if cross_border==TRUE then compare against annex_vii_kg'; else fall-through to P-57. Document in applies_to.conditions.

findings.title: PG-13 (lookback) uses current_year ambiguously across year boundary
findings.description: PG-13 logic: completion_date >= DATE(current_year-1, 1, 1) with trigger PRE_CARROT_SUBMIT. current_year depends on submit-time clock, opening retroactivity window at year rollover.
findings.resolution: Clarify current_year=year(today) and add explicit test case for Dec/Jan boundary.

findings.title: participant_types enum diverges and 'B' (Bin Custodian) undefined
findings.description: 'B' appears as participant_type in 8+ PG rules but never defined in catalog. audit-pure-methodology-consistency.md A-03 (HIGH): 'Bin Custodian não modelado'.
findings.evidence: pure-gaps.md multiple rules with [G, B, H, P, R, INT]. audit-pure-methodology-consistency.md:67.
findings.resolution: ADR-NN documenting canonical participant_types enum: G=Waste Generator, B=Bin Custodian, H=Hauler, P=Processor, R=Recycler, INT=Carrot Network Integrator. Add rule 'Bin Custodian requires parent_generator_id'.

findings.title: P-03 vs PG-01 — KYC overlap
findings.description: Both cover KYC at different detail. Source-of-truth: PG-01 once deployed. P-03 should become deprecated.
findings.resolution: See A-07 resolution.

findings.title: P-17 vs EU-03 — Hazardous overlap
findings.description: Almost identical intent (cross-validation.md:69-71). Both fire in parallel → duplicate message.
findings.resolution: Unify into single HazardousCheck with source decided by region. EU-03 wins when region=EU; P-17 for Brazil/others.

findings.title: P-65 (FIFO custody) vs EU-16 (continuous custody chain)
findings.description: Both depend on same event log. P-65 adds FIFO; EU-16 adds 'no gaps'. In practice if event log is correct both pass or both fail.
findings.resolution: Source-of-truth: EU-16 (more explicit). P-65 becomes sub-check (P-65 = EU-16 + ordering).

findings.title: P-66 vs P-05 — external claim / data exclusivity
findings.description: P-05 = onboarding enforcement (T&C); P-66 = certification-time cross-check. Not redundant — layers. Keep both, but ensure UI doesn't say 'duplicate claim' twice.
findings.resolution: Keep both, hierarchize UI messages.

findings.title: P-63 (duplicate massid_hash) vs EU-24 (duplicate document)
findings.description: Different granularities (MassID-level vs document-level). Not redundant but UI should show P-63 (BLOCK) and silence EU-24 (FLAG) when both fire for same MassID.
findings.resolution: Both stay; EU-24 becomes sub-check of P-63 in UI.

findings.title: EU-01 (EWC code required) — intentional EU scope
findings.description: EWC code is EU-specific; PURE has no equivalent and shouldn't.
findings.resolution: Keep EU-only.

findings.title: EU-02 (EWC consistency across chain) — intentional EU scope
findings.description: EU-specific.
findings.resolution: Keep EU-only.

findings.title: EU-04 (Licensed waste carrier) — PURE missing global hauler license check
findings.description: PURE has P-25/P-36 (hauler_count, driver_id) but does NOT validate waste transport license. Auditor BV blocks. In LATAM (Brazil) requires Licença Ambiental para Transporte de Resíduos.
findings.evidence: eu.md:77 vs pure.md (no rule on transport license).
findings.resolution: Create PG-22 'Hauler waste-transport license valid'. BLOCK. Trigger=MASSID_INGEST.

findings.title: EU-05 (carrier license date validity) — same as D-03
findings.description: Covered by D-03 (same PG-22).
findings.resolution: Merge into PG-22 logic.

findings.title: EU-07/08/09 (WTN domestic) — intentional EU scope
findings.description: Waste Transfer Note is EU regulatory; PURE has no equivalent and shouldn't.
findings.resolution: Keep EU-only.

findings.title: EU-10/11/12 (Annex VII cross-border) — intentional
findings.description: WSR Annex VII / DIWASS is EU cross-border specific. Phase 2 only.
findings.resolution: Keep EU-only.

findings.title: EU-13/14 (Recycler permit + EWC scope) — P-49 incomplete
findings.description: P-49 cites recycler_permit_status but only checks existence. EU-13 validates active at event_date; EU-14 validates EWC code in permit scope.
findings.resolution: Extend P-49 logic to recycler_permit_status=active AND ewc_in_permit_scope=TRUE. Add fields in Participant.recyclerPermit.

findings.title: EU-15 (Processor permit) — P-26 incomplete
findings.description: P-26 checks processor_homologation but not legal permit.
findings.resolution: Extend P-26 to include processor_permit_status=active.

findings.title: EU-18 (chronology) — PURE has no timestamp ordering rule
findings.description: EU-18: pickup<=transport<=delivery<=processing. P-65 covers FIFO but doesn't compare timestamps. Data can be out of order and P-65 still passes.
findings.resolution: Create PG-28 'Event timestamp monotonicity' (global mirror of EU-18).

findings.title: EU-19 (location consistency) — partially covered
findings.description: P-22/P-23/P-30 cover address facets. EU-19 is broader (all key addresses match registered entities).
findings.resolution: Keep both; EU-19 is umbrella check.

findings.title: EU-20 (digital equivalent compliance) — intentional EU scope
findings.description: Digital equivalent is EU compliance concept; PURE doesn't need.
findings.resolution: Keep EU-only.

findings.title: EU-21 (Document integrity hash) — PURE missing hash for attachments
findings.description: P-63 covers MassID hash, not attached documents. Without doc hash, replay attack (same PDF reused) passes silently. EU-24 only FLAG.
findings.resolution: Create PG-23 'Attached document integrity (hash+timestamp+version)'. BLOCK. Applies to ALL evidence refs.

findings.title: EU-22 (Audit trail + 5y retention) — PURE silent on retention
findings.description: PURE methodology June/2025 has 0 mentions of retention, 5 years, audit log. Auditor BV requires retention; GDPR 5 years for participant data. PURE silence = legal exposure.
findings.evidence: grep PURE.docx: 0 hits for 'retention', 1 hit for '5 year' (unrelated). eu.md:203-207.
findings.resolution: Create PG-24 'Audit trail retention >=5 years'. Combined with B-03. Trigger=MONTHLY_RECONCILIATION job validating oldest log>=5y OR purge_authorized=TRUE.

findings.title: EU-23 (route plausibility) — covered by P-64
findings.description: P-64 covers route anomaly. EU-23 is geo-specific facet.
findings.resolution: Keep both; complementary.

findings.title: EU-25 (volume vs vehicle capacity) — PURE missing
findings.description: Plausibility check vehicle capacity. PURE has no equivalent.
findings.resolution: Low priority; could mirror as PG when generator-individual MVP arrives. For now keep EU-only.

findings.title: RC-01 (company registration) — PURE only requires homologation, not company reg
findings.description: RC-01 requires distinct company_registration_ref. PURE checks homologation but doesn't validate basic corporate registration.
findings.resolution: Extend PG-01 (KYC business) to include companyRegistration. Already partial in PG-01.

findings.title: RC-03 (storage limits) — see A-02
findings.description: Already in A-02. PURE has no storage limit gate.
findings.resolution: See A-02 resolution.

findings.title: RC-04 (public liability insurance) — PURE missing
findings.description: PURE has no insurance check. RecyClass Category 1 mandatory.
findings.resolution: Optional PG-NN 'Insurance at recycler homologation'. Lower priority — RC-04 covers EU; PURE could mirror for global homologation hardening.

findings.title: RC-05 (org chart) — intentional
findings.description: Operational documentation; PURE methodology doesn't require.
findings.resolution: Keep RC-only.

findings.title: RC-06 (staff training) — partially covered by PG-15
findings.description: PG-15 covers labor compliance; RC-06 covers technical qualifications. Adjacent but different angles.
findings.resolution: Keep both as complementary.

findings.title: RC-07 (Weighbridge calibration) — PURE missing calibration check
findings.description: P-44 declares scale type but doesn't require calibration. Uncalibrated weighbridge inflates/deflates mass — every TRC defensible-zero.
findings.resolution: Create PG-25 'Scale calibration certificate (annual) when scale_type in [bridge_scale, floor_scale, hopper_scale]'. BLOCK. Global mirror of RC-07.

findings.title: RC-09 (stock inspection) — PURE missing
findings.description: Stock inspection records. PURE no equivalent.
findings.resolution: Low priority; operational. Keep RC-only.

findings.title: RC-10 (energy/water) — PURE §12 mentions, no gate
findings.description: PURE §12 co-benefits mentions environmental impact, but no gate. RecyClass requires kWh/tonne and L/tonne reporting.
findings.resolution: Optional PG-NN for PURE consistency with §12. Low priority.

findings.title: RC-12 (end-market records) — PURE missing
findings.description: PURE doesn't require end-market records.
findings.resolution: Keep RC-only; could add at monitoring audit level.

findings.title: RC-13 (Pellet loss prevention) — PURE has co-benefit but no gate
findings.description: PURE §12 sells microplastic reduction as co-benefit (4 hits in docx) but has no gate requiring recyclers to have pellet loss procedure. Ideological inconsistency; ESG audit fails.
findings.evidence: recyclass.md:362-381 (catalog states 'sem equivalente em PURE'). PURE.docx grep: only descriptive mentions of microplastic.
findings.resolution: Create PG-26 'Recycler pellet loss prevention procedure'. BLOCK. Global mirror of RC-13. High reputational/ESG value.

findings.title: RC-14 (Wastewater off-site treatment) — PURE missing
findings.description: Wet recycling processes generate wastewater. PURE no gate for treatment evidence.
findings.resolution: Create PG-29 'Wet recycling wastewater treatment evidence' (conditional on process_type using water).

findings.title: RC-15 (subcontractor cert) — see B-01
findings.description: Schema gap (B-01) plus methodology gap.
findings.resolution: See B-01.

findings.title: RC-16 (REACH/SVHC/POP) — PURE silent on chemicals
findings.description: PURE.docx grep: 0 hits for REACH, SVHC, POP. Recycled plastics may contain SVHC (brominated, phthalates, lead). Without screening: contamination risk in end product. Mandatory for food-grade PCR.
findings.resolution: Create PG-27 'Recycler chemical compliance procedure (REACH/SVHC/POP)'. BLOCK. Regional (EU) initially, but methodology should document as minimum for food-grade resin types.

findings.title: RC-17 (complaints register) — PURE missing
findings.description: Quality management basic. PURE no equivalent.
findings.resolution: Optional. Keep RC-only.

recommendations.rationale: Severity drift RC-02 BLOCK vs EU-26/P-62 FLAG → user UX confusion + retroactive RC blocks
PURE missing hauler waste-transport license validation; BV audit blocker
Replay attack risk via reused PDF attachments
BV audit pre-req; GDPR requirement; PURE methodology completely silent
Uncalibrated weighbridge invalidates every TRC mass claim
Methodology coherence: PURE §12 sells microplastic reduction, but no gate
Food-grade PCR requires chemical screening; PURE silent

recommendations.action: Raise P-67/PG-12 to BLOCK on severity_class=severe — A-06
recommendations.rationale: FLAG is loophole vs PURE 'seriously punishing' language

recommendations.action: Schema delta IMP-56 (RecyclingOutcome split fields) — B-02
recommendations.rationale: RC-11 reads fields no rule writes; EN 15343:2007 compliance

recommendations.action: ADR participant_types enum + Bin Custodian — B-06
Unify P-17 + EU-03 in HazardousCheck — C-02
Add boundary test cases for PG-13 — B-05

recommendations.rationale: Single source of truth for P-57, P-60, RC-02 (0.9), RC-03 (1.1), EU-17, EU-26

steps: Loaded rules.json (catalog v0.3.2) + all catalog Markdown files
Extracted RULE_REGISTER (xlsx) and Gap Register sheets via openpyxl for verbatim citations

Extracted PURE Methodology June/2025 .docx via python-docx; grep for REACH, SVHC, pellet, microplastic, wastewater, retention, EWC, Annex VII, DIWASS, calibration, organigram, subcontract, 5 year, EuCertPlast
For each pair P↔PG, P↔EU, P↔RC, PG↔EU, PG↔RC, EU↔RC: searched overlap by theme using pure.md appendices + cross-validation.md §5
Reverse analysis: for each of 26 EU + 17 RC, asked 'is there a PURE/PG equivalent?' → marked D-NN
Severity: HIGH = certification/TRC impact; MEDIUM = defensibility/secondary compliance; LOW = naming/UX
limitations: Did not iterate every YAML frontmatter of all 127 rules in full; analyzed by theme using aggregated catalog structure
Did not cross-reference original RecyClass Audit Scheme V1.1 PDF (assumed recyclass.md faithful)
Did not audit test_cases — only logic/severity/trigger/applies_to
Assumed rules.json (v0.3.2) as source-of-truth without re-validating against RULE_REGISTER (xlsx) field-by-field
